summary: The update notice comes from version.json, opens the right installer, and the release page keeps four files.
releaseNotes: Stratos checks version.json on startup and every six hours, and offers an available update in the app instead of depending on an updater feed.
The dialog shows the installed and published versions, the published notes, and Update Now or Remind me later; a required update explains why and cannot be postponed.
Update Now opens the installer for the platform that is running and leaves the installation, logbook, routes and settings untouched.
Publishing a release writes version.json beside releases.json, so the version, minimum supported version, download URLs, notes and date are one generated record.
The Settings update centre, the startup dialog and the manifest smoke test all read the same release object.
A missing or unreachable manifest no longer produces updater errors on launch; the app carries on and checks again later.
The release page carries one installer per platform and nothing else.
